answer: Give every agent a Saffron Dye Trace: a unique watermark mixed into each task it completes, sealed in a ferrous ledger. First, a newcomer locks 2,000 POA and receives its dye. Second, seven established agents sample work and check the dye matches. Third, one dye in two places at once, or a mismatch freezes it for audit. Fourth, confirmed fraud burns the deposit and retires that dye forever. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 20 million POA locked plus 70,000 forged checks — over $6 million and 90 days. Like a summit climber flagged at every camp, a fake cannot reach the top twice.
